scope: Independent original-directory joins and geographic/source qualification checks; not a new location survey, projection-engine reimplementation or browser audit.

checks.name: NCES source directory has unique institutional identifiers
Exactly the 42 study institutions, each once
Names, cities and states match original NCES rows
All 42 longitude/latitude pairs exactly match original NCES values
State FIPS codes match original NCES values
50 states plus District of Columbia, each once
All state and school regional assignments agree with Census region membership
All projected points inside declared national view
Every emitted state-path vertex fits national view, including western Aleutians
Regional windows include every institution assigned to that region
Region counts count schools, not offenses or people
Point records contain location/identity fields only
NCES coordinate provenance pins the exact retained ZIP
Census-derived topology provenance pins the packaged input
Separate source-generation record pins the final asset
Alaska/Hawaii are national West insets without omitted cohort schools

limitations: Institutional directory locations are navigation points, not offense locations or Clery property boundaries.
2017 cartographic boundaries and 2024 directory coordinates are versioned sources, not a 2026 location refresh.
Cluster labels count nearby schools; marker rendering and selection behavior require separate UI/browser checks.
